 Here are the Predictions for Nepal Premier League 2026, 4th Match - Pokhara Avengers vs Sudurpaschim Royals, to be played on the 28th of October at the Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground, Kirtipur.
 Match Prediction - Pokhara Avengers v Sudurpaschim Royals 
 4th Match - Pokhara Avengers vs Sudurpaschim Royals (Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground, Kirtipur) 
 Ground Stat:
 Average 1st Innings Total at Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground, Kirtipur (Nepal Premier League) - 157 
 Average 2nd Innings Total at Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground, Kirtipur (Nepal Premier League) - 137 
 Batting Stats T20 
 Current Form Pokhara Avengers:
 Pokhara Avengers performed poorly in the last edition of Nepal Premier League. They managed to win only 3 games and failed to qualify for the Playoffs. 
 The top run scorer for Pokhara Avengers in the last edition of Nepal Premier League was Adam Rossington with 323 runs to his name. 
 The top wicket taker for Pokhara Avengers in the last edition of Nepal Premier League was Dhananjaya Lakshan with 10 scalps under his belt. 
 Pokhara Avengers are looking quite strong this season. They have plenty of match winners in their squad including Kushal Bhurtel, Shakib Al Hasan, Chamika Karunaratne and Sagar Dhakal. 
 Pokhara Avengers are expected to make it to the Playoffs with ease. 
 Players to look out for:
 1. Kushal Bhurtel - He is a very talented top order batter, who more often than not takes responsibility for his team when they are in troubled waters. He is expected to score plenty of runs in the competition.
 2. Sagar Dhakal - He is one of the best spinners in Nepal domestic circuit. Dhakal has plenty of variations in his bowling arsenal. He will play a key role for Pokhara Avengers in the upcoming matches with the ball in hand.
 Current Form Sudurpaschim Royals:
 Sudurpaschim Royals are currently placed at the bottom most position on points table with 1 loss to their credit. 
 The top run scorer for Sudurpaschim Royals in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Dipendra Singh Airee with 27 runs to his name. 
 The top wicket taker for Sudurpaschim Royals in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Anil Kharel with 2 scalps under his belt. 
 Sudurpaschim Royals have lost their previous match against Lumbini Lions by 7 wickets.
 Sudurpaschim Royals batted first and they posted a total of 87 before being bowled out. Saif Zaib, Binod Bhandari and Aarif Sheikh all got out cheaply and Sudurpaschim Royals got off to the most horrible start. Brandon McMullen also got out cheaply. Dipendra Singh Airee tried to revive the innings with a knock of 27 runs but he kept losing partners in regular succession. Sudurpaschim Royals could never gain momentum into the innings and they were eventually bowled out for just 87.
 During the chase, Lumbini Lions started off very well. Openers D'Arcy Short and Aasif Sheikh were really calculative in their shot selection. Short made 40 runs off 18 balls while Sheikh scored 32 runs in 25 deliveries to seal the deal in favor of Lumbini Lions. They chased the target quite comfortably in the 10th over itself with 7 wickets in hand.
